text: 1.Applicants must be a citizen of a country other than the People’s Republic of China, and be in good mental and physical health.2.The requirements for applicants’ degree and age are that applicants must be a bachelor’s degree holder and no more than 35 years old when applying for the master’s programs.3.Other kinds of Chinese Government Scholarships are not obtained at the same time.4. Eligible Countries for Application: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Mongolia, Georgia, Turkey, Italy, Indonesia, Thailand.
